# Pinned Custom Elements Manifest schema

`schema.json` and `LICENSE` are unmodified copies from
https://github.com/webcomponents/custom-elements-manifest/tree/d2f79f0d22c4d48a68628cf867c2319576ffc5d2
(retrieved 2026-09-22).

Used only for offline standard-compatibility tests. Not distributed as a Design
Lasagna schema export. Tests validate full manifests and compose standard entry
fragments with our permissive lifecycle fragments; neither replaces the other.
